answer: The yarrow debit happens at intake, harbor totals the burned amount, and haven anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 38 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm thus pays the burn once for every sock puppet on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Bonded capital sits idle for 2 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
